prompt: When someone submits our Typeform contact form, create the lead in Pipedrive as organization, person and deal.

plan.summary: When a Typeform contact form is submitted, create an organization, a person, and a deal in Pipedrive linked to that person.

source.docsQuery: Typeform API webhook form response submitted fields

target.docsQuery: Pipedrive API create organization create person create deal endpoints

fieldMapping.note: Typeform name field maps to Pipedrive organization name
Typeform email field maps to Pipedrive person email
Typeform phone field maps to Pipedrive person phone number
Typeform company field maps to Pipedrive organization name (if different from name)
Map specific text answers (e.g. 'What is your project?') to the deal title

assumptions: The Typeform includes fields for full name, email, phone, and company.
Pipedrive API requires creating the organization first, then the person linked to that organization, then the deal linked to the person.
The user will provide specific text answer IDs from Typeform to map to the deal title.
All required Pipedrive API tokens and custom field IDs are configured in the patchbay environment.

notes: Webhook delivers JSON payload via POST to HTTPS endpoint.
Answers array contains objects with 'type' and answer value (e.g., 'text', 'email').
Each answer includes a 'field' object with 'id' to map to question.
Text answers for deal title must be identified by field ID from Typeform definition.
No authentication on webhook; security relies on HTTPS and optional secret (not in docs).
Requires Bearer token in Authorization header.
Creates organization; returns organization ID needed for person linking.
Only 'name' is required; other fields optional.
Response includes 'id' for use in subsequent calls.
Requires Bearer token in Authorization header.
Person must be linked to organization via 'organization_id'.
Email and phone are arrays of objects with 'value' and 'primary' flags.
At least one email or phone required; name is required.
Requires Bearer token in Authorization header.
Deal must be linked to person via 'person_id' and optionally organization via 'org_id'.
'title' is required; other fields like value, currency, stage_id have defaults.
Response includes deal ID and linked person/org details.
Assumes default pipeline and stage; user may need to specify via pipeline_id/stage_id if non-default.
